headline: Telefonica Germany ties 1,100 job cuts to AI
body: A quiet day with one story. O2 Germany confirmed it will cut more than 1,100 jobs by end-2026, citing greater use of AI. That slightly lowers Shared Prosperity, nudging Egalitarian Utopia down. Other lines drifted as earlier news faded. Horizon Balance eased to -0.53.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Egalitarian Utopia -0.05, from the Telefonica Germany job cuts (-0.06), partly offset by fading earlier news (+0.02); Protector God -0.05, from fading earlier news (-0.05).
